text:
marie: Quick heads-up — launching the new 'Policy Glossary' section in the handbook today. It's meant to make Q&A easier and shorten manager responses. Link: https://handbook.redwood.ai/policy-glossary :sparkles:

sam: Nice! Is this replacing the FAQ doc or supplementary?

marie: Supplementary. Core policies still in place. Glossary: short definitions + cross-links to policies. We also added a 'manager talking points' micro-kit.

leo: Can you drop the translation spreadsheet? I can coordinate EMEA reviews.

marie: Yup — sheet (edit for managers only): https://sheets.redwood.ai/policy-glossary-translations
Please add your region and owner in column B. We need first pass by EOD Friday.

tanya: FYI — legal requested a minor wording change on 'data retention' section. I'll paste diff in the sheet.

devon: For training — proposing 20-minute drop-in sessions next week, 3 slots/day. Is mandatory for managers? :thinking_face: 

marie: Mandatory for people managers and anyone in hiring/mics. Individual contributors optional but encouraged. We'll auto-enroll managers and send calendar invites.

people-ops-bot: Reminder scheduled — "Policy Glossary: Manager micro-session (20m)" will be sent to enrolled managers at 9am PT tomorrow.

sam: Can we get a short slide deck or one-pager to share with teams? I can adapt for Sales.

marie: Yes — created a 1-page "cheat sheet" in Drive. Link in sheet under 'assets' tab. If you need access ping me.

leo: EMEA reviewers — I'll run through entries for GD/UK and flag legal q's. ETA Thurs noon.

tanya: Noted. Marrying legal edits + translations might push timeline, but we'll keep manager sessions as-is and add an addendum if needed.

marie: Thanks all. Action items in sheet: owners flagged, training RSVP column, and "go-live note" for comms team. Will post a short announcement in #general after manager invites go out. :thumbsup:

devon: Added myself to reviewer list for APAC.

sam: Added RSVP for my team.

marie: Closing loop — if you still need edit access DM me. Otherwise will proceed with invites at noon PT.
